title: JukeboxPack-Discs
description: Adds Lost of new songs / Replaces Discs with other songs some what related to minecraft. My personal favourites are The Bagel song and Hypixel, you'll have to check them out. Trust me its great.
body:
This resource pack replaces most of Minecraft’s music discs with new custom songs. Each disc now plays a different track, giving your game a fresh soundtrack while still keeping the original disc mechanics intact.

**Features:**

- Replaces nearly every music disc with a new song
  
- Mix of Minecraft-themed and non-Minecraft tracks
  
- Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer (client-side)
  
- No gameplay changes — only audio is modified

Perfect for players who want a new listening experience while exploring, building, or farming without installing mods.
